_note: Platform -> official TAKE IT DOWN / NCII removal channel. Order = priority. 'verified': true means the channel was confirmed from the platform's own page; false means confirm before relying on it. Values in fields[].value are placeholders from api/templates/notice.md or literal answers.

platforms.name: X
platforms.in_app_path: Post > ... menu > Private or Non-Consensual Content > Report content under the US Take It Down Act

fields.question: What issue are you having?
fields.value: I'd like to submit a US Take It Down Act Report

fields.question: Report a sexual, nude, or intimate photo/video of:
fields.value: Someone else without permission on which I'm the authorized representative

fields.question: Username of the account you are reporting
Please share the content that might be violating our rules
Please provide more details about what's happening

checkboxes.label: It's okay to include the content being reported in updates sent to me in the future.
checkboxes.why: Leave unticked: we never want the intimate media sent to our inbox. Raw media stays out of our systems.

checkboxes.label: I have a good faith belief that the intimate visual depiction(s) identified above were published without my consent (or without the consent of the person I am authorized to represent).
checkboxes.why: Statutory statement (Act 3(a)(1)(B)(iii)). Tick only after the user clicked 'This is me' and 'Not consensual'.

checkboxes.label: By checking this box, I confirm that the information provided in this form is accurate.

platforms.name: Instagram (Meta)
platforms.notes: Instagram's NCII report form. Asks if the person was under 18 (routes to NCMEC Take It Down) and points adults to StopNCII.

platforms.name: Facebook (Meta)
platforms.in_app_path: Post > ... > Report > Nudity or sexual activity > Sharing private images
platforms.notes: Meta has not published a separate TAKE IT DOWN form we could confirm. Use the in-app report; confirm the direct form link.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.in_app_path: Video > Share arrow > Report > Sexual content > link to report non-consensual intimate imagery
platforms.notes: In-app path from news coverage; confirm the direct web form link.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.notes: Direct TAKE IT DOWN form not confirmed yet; check Reddit Help Center.

platforms.name: Snapchat
platforms.in_app_path: Press and hold the Snap or Story > Report > nudity / sexual content of me (NCII category)
platforms.notes: Snap says reporting is in-app with dedicated NCII categories; confirm any web form.

platforms.name: Bluesky
platforms.notes: TAKE IT DOWN notice form; takes the post or account URL and covers AI-generated or altered content.

platforms.name: StopNCII.org
platforms.notes: Not a takedown notice. The person makes a hash of the image on their own device; partner platforms block matching uploads. Adults only, and the person must submit it themselves (no representatives), so Six Eyes can only suggest it to the user.
